title: Payroll System
description:
```
Name        Type        Pay
Alice       Salaried    $5,000.00
Bob         Hourly      $1,240.00 (31h @ $40, 0h overtime)
Cara        Commission  $3,750.00 (base + 5% of $55,000)
Dan         Intern      $800.00
TOTAL                   $10,790.00
```
hints: The table prints the same way for everyone: the base class can have a non-virtual `printRow()` that calls the virtual `monthlyPay()` and `details()`. Each subclass only supplies the numbers.
Overtime: `const double normal{ std::min(hours, 160.0) }; const double extra{ std::max(0.0, hours - 160.0) }; pay = rate * (normal + extra * 1.5);`.
requirements: An abstract `Employee` with a name, a pure virtual `monthlyPay()` and a virtual `details()`
`Salaried`, `Hourly` (time and a half after 160 hours), `Commission` (a base plus a percentage of sales) and `Intern`
A list of employees in a `std::vector<std::unique_ptr<Employee>>`, printed as a payslip table with the total
stretch: A `Manager` that holds non-owning `Employee*` pointers to a team and earns a bonus per person.
